description: Intersection File - City of Toronto is a dataset listed in City of Toronto open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Toronto. This data was collected for planning and mapping purposes and includes all intersections within the City of Toronto. This data set is limited to the City of Toronto geographical boundary. It is a GIS file and works best when you open it with GIS software and overlay it with the City of Toronto Street Centreline. Coverage: Toronto. The portal files it under the publisher City of Toronto. Its tags are intersections. It offers 9 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, GPKG, SHP. The portal shows 2026-09-30 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-toronto-portal.
